description: Post a Discussion comment on a program brief, into the same thread the console shows. By default it anchors to the brief's `overview` section; pass `section` to target another brief section, or `parentId` to reply to an existing comment. The comment is always stored private to the team — there is no way to make it visible to a client from here. Requires `write` scope and an editor-capable key owner.

parentId.description: Reply target — the id of the comment being replied to.

section.description: Brief section to anchor to (default overview). One of: overview, problemStatement, solutionSummary, context, mlpScope, userStories, nonFunctionalRequirements, technicalScope, dependencies, assumptions, nonGoals, complianceRequirements, successMetrics, financialModel.

name: anyforge_post_program_comment
title: Post program comment
